_comment: Process / chemical engineering job search, Germany-wide.
Query terms come from json_tag.txt (2026-08-04): every tag there was lifted
from a live German posting rather than invented, so these are the phrasings
employers actually use.
PORTALS. defaults hold the three that measurably carry this field:
arbeitsagentur (official federal API, all sectors - the backbone), stepstone,
and freehire. arbeitnow is deliberately absent: probed with
'Verfahrensingenieur', 'Process Engineer' and 'Werkstudent Verfahrenstechnik'
it returned 0 results every time - it is a tech/remote board and carries
nothing for this field. xing and linkedin are personal-use-only per their
SKILL.md, so they are opted into the four core title profiles only, to keep
request volume low rather than firing on all twelve.
NO exclude_titles. Werkstudent, Praktikum and Abschlussarbeit roles are
TARGETS here (tag categories 2 and 3), not noise. Over-filtering hides real
jobs; under-filtering only adds a row you can skim past.
LOCATION is intentionally unset = nationwide. The source postings span
Frankfurt, Berlin, Essen, Hamburg, Leverkusen and Landau, so pinning one city
would cut most of them. The two portals that need an explicit scope get it
once in defaults.portal_overrides: linkedin requires a location string, and
freehire is worldwide unless given --country.

profiles._note: English variant, overlaps heavily with process-engineer-en. Flip on for wider English coverage.
Broad energy-transition net: high volume, lower precision. Enable if the targeted energy profiles run dry.
